## Silicon Lifecycle Management

::: {.pub-list}
1. **Ni, H. P.**\*, & Chakrabarty, K. (2026). [Silicon Lifecycle Management: From Telemetry to Dependability](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11480834). *IEEE Design & Test*.

2. Ortega, E.\*, **Ni, H. P.**, Hati, A., Talukdar, J., Paik, W., Su, F., Chattopadhyay, R., and Chakrabarty, K. (2026). X-OCTANE: eXplainable On-Chip Telemetry-based Anomaly Notification Engine for Silicon Lifecycle Management, to appear in *ACM Transactions on Design Automation of Electronic Systems*.

3. **Ni, H. P.**\*, Ortega, E., and Chakrabarty, K. (2026). EXACT: Edge-eXplainable Autonomous Causal Telemetry for Silicon Lifecycle Management, to appear in *IEEE European Test Symposium (ETS)*.

4. Ortega, E.\*, Talukdar, J., **Ni, H. P.**, and Chakrabarty, K. (2026). TRACK: Telemetry-based Representation Analysis via Centered Kernel Alignment for Silicon Lifecycle Management, to appear in *IEEE VLSI Test Symposium (VTS)*.

5. **Ni, H. P.**\*, and Chakrabarty, K. (2026). DICE: A Digital Twin-Driven In-Field Continuous-Test Engine for Silicon Lifecycle Management. *IEEE International Test Conference (ITC)*. Under review.

6. **Ni, H. P.**\*, and Chakrabarty, K. (2026). CITADEL: Causal In-Field Telemetry Analytics and Drift-Aware Edge Learning for Silicon Lifecycle Management. *IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems*. Manuscript in preparation.
